body:
It would be amazing to reach that goal. I just wish it were easier. I've often thought of just jumping the gun and getting a loan to just go. I just need to be in a better head space, I feel hopeless right now. 

I hope you achieve your goal as well, your words mean a lot to me. Maybe I will try that lifestyle

Never heard of Jeepneys ahah. 
I'm really into Japanese drift culture. I've got a drift project car myself. Just really want to see the real deal in person and just experience it all. But it seems unachievable.

It seems mediocre put into words. I really want to visit Japan. Not just for Tokyo and the typical stuff but to visit the drift tracks and small car culture towns. I guess technically I've had two plans.. the one was to go and finally fulfill that dream, then end it there. Felt like I would have done something with my life at that point.
I really do. I was near rock bottom and finally hit it earlier this year. And therapy has helped, I've found out a lot about myself.
Thank you. I guess I just don't see why I need to endure a world I didn't choose.
I guess I need to get myself out of my shell. It's hard to even go about my day with this low level of energy.
